tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The window background, the darkest layer. Also the ink on the primary button and on the unread badge. Palette.ground. Porcelain makes it a pale grey (#ebebee): the one light palette.

tokens.name: ground-glow
tokens.usage: Centre of the radial glow behind every screen (at 120,0, radius 1400 px, fading to ground). The only place a palette shows its hue.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Material surface: dialogs, menus and other solid panels that sit on the ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: A cover's placeholder while it loads or when there is none; Material surfaceVariant.

tokens.name: glass-solid
tokens.usage: Solid stand-in for every glass panel when Reduce transparency is on.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface and on glass; the fill of the primary button and unread badge. Material primary. Porcelain flips it to near-black #17171a (15:1 on its ground).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, placeholders, unselected labels and icons. At least 6.8:1 on every palette's surfaces (WCAG AA).

tokens.name: rim
tokens.usage: Bottom of the glass rim gradient, card borders, and the tint of glass controls (buttons, fields, banners, segmented track). Material outlineVariant.

tokens.name: rim-bright
tokens.usage: Top of the glass rim gradient and the account ring border. Material outline.

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Dark tint laid over the blur on large glass (sidebar, card captions); light enough to stay see-through. Multiplied by the Glass strength setting (0.5–1.5).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on every control.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Rank 1 and the rating star in search results.

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: Rank 2.

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: Rank 3.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Success state text, e.g. a matched source in the Source Picker. Never the only signal.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and the excluded state of a tri-state chip. Material error. Never the only signal: pair with ✕, a strikethrough or words.

tokens.name: rank-gold-fill
tokens.usage: Rank chip fill for #1 (gold at 85%).

tokens.name: rank-silver-fill
tokens.usage: Rank chip fill for #2 (silver at 85%).

tokens.name: rank-bronze-fill
tokens.usage: Rank chip fill for #3 (bronze at 85%).

tokens.name: rank-plain-fill
tokens.usage: Rank chip fill from #4 down, with text ink.

tokens.name: rank-gold-ink
tokens.usage: Numeral on the gold rank chip.

tokens.name: rank-silver-ink
tokens.usage: Numeral on the silver rank chip.

tokens.name: rank-bronze-ink
tokens.usage: Numeral on the bronze rank chip.

tokens.name: rank-rim
tokens.usage: 1 px border on every rank chip.

tokens.name: droplet-top
tokens.usage: Top of the droplet's vertical gradient, and its 1 px rim. On Porcelain the droplet becomes a solid white pill lifted by shadow-droplet.

tokens.name: droplet-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of the droplet's vertical gradient.

tokens.name: chip-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the small label chip (type, genre) on card captions.

tokens.name: chip-rim
tokens.usage: Border of the small label chip; also the skeleton block fill.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover highlight behind a search result row.

tokens.name: card-highlight
tokens.usage: Top of the 56 px highlight fading down from a title card's top edge.

tokens.name: text-shadow
tokens.usage: Soft shadow (blur 6) under text on glass captions, so it holds 4.5:1 over bright covers.

tokens.name: tri-none-fill
tokens.usage: Tri-state chip, not selected: fill (rim border, muted label).

tokens.name: tri-included-fill
tokens.usage: Tri-state chip, included: fill, with a ✓ and text label.

tokens.name: tri-included-rim
tokens.usage: Tri-state chip, included: border.

tokens.name: tri-excluded-fill
tokens.usage: Tri-state chip, excluded: fill, with a danger ✕ and a struck-through label.

tokens.name: tri-excluded-rim
tokens.usage: Tri-state chip, excluded: border (danger at 60%).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one hue in the interface (orange, from the app styleguide). Focus glow, the accent alert icon, active tab underline, the knob of an ArrowButton, a small unread dot. Not for text on the ground: 3.2:1 on Porcelain, so icons and rings only.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the one accent call to action per screen (GlassButton accent, ArrowButton accent, a selected accent chip). Darker than accent so white accent-ink holds 4.8:1.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Label and icon on accent-fill (4.8:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Wash behind an accent alert and a hovered accent chip.

tokens.name: accent-rim
tokens.usage: 1 px border of the accent alert and the accent focus ring on soft fields.

tokens.name: ink-fill
tokens.usage: The inverted strong pill: the open group in the Sidebar panel, the ToggleIconButton when on, count badges. Same as text, named for fills.

tokens.name: ink-on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink-fill.

tokens.name: soft-light
tokens.usage: The light half of a soft (neumorphic) shadow: top-left highlight. Shown in the shadow-soft-* tokens.

tokens.name: soft-dark
tokens.usage: The dark half of a soft shadow: bottom-right falloff.

tokens.name: tree-line
tokens.usage: The 1 px guide joining a Sidebar panel group to its children, and its tick on the current child.

styles.name: headline-small
styles.usage: Shelf names and the large muted rank numeral in result rows. Material headlineSmall.

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: Result row titles, empty and error state titles. Material titleLarge.

styles.name: title-medium
styles.usage: Rank chip numerals, the year and rating in result rows. Material titleMedium.

styles.name: title-small
styles.usage: Title card captions (two lines max). Material titleSmall.

styles.name: body-large
styles.usage: Text typed into search and text fields, and their placeholders. Material bodyLarge.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.sample: Showing MangaDex results — Comick is unavailable
styles.usage: Default running text: banners, descriptions, state details. Material bodyMedium.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Metadata lines in result rows. Material bodySmall.

styles.name: label-large
styles.usage: Button labels, account initials. Material labelLarge.

styles.name: label-medium
styles.usage: Segmented options, tri-state chips, field labels, unread badges. Material labelMedium.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Caption chips, ratings and counts on cards, sidebar labels. Material labelSmall.

spacing.note: Space in Theme.kt. Components also use 6, 10 and 14 px inline (gaps and pill padding); those are not tokens in the source.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Segmented track padding, gap between a field label and its box.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Caption inset inside a title card, gap in state messages.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Banner gaps, tri-state chip side padding, text field padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Banner side padding, gap between columns in result rows and between a shelf title and its switch.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Gaps between sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Screen side inset; shelves scroll edge to edge inside it.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Gap between a widget card's header row and its body.

radius.note: Glass is soft: controls are full pills, containers 12–18 px, the sidebar 30 px.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Small label chip on captions.

tokens.name: radius-thumb
tokens.usage: Cover thumbnail in a result row.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Text fields, rank chips, skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: radius-caption
tokens.usage: Frosted caption inside a title card (card radius minus its 8 px inset, plus 3).

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Banners and search result rows.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Title cards and their skeletons.

tokens.name: radius-sidebar
tokens.usage: The floating sidebar pill.

tokens.name: radius-menu
tokens.usage: MorphSelect popover, Sidebar flyout, soft square search button.

tokens.name: radius-widget
tokens.usage: Widget cards (the large soft white card that hosts a MorphSelect) and the Sidebar panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon buttons, search field, segmented switch and droplet, tri-state chips, badges, avatars.

shadow.note: CSS renditions of Compose shadow(elevation) in pure black; the source gives only the elevation in dp.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Elevation 12 dp: GlassSurface (sidebar, floating panels).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Card at rest: a bright 1 px top edge, a tight contact shadow and a soft drop that falls down-right (light from the top-left). TitleCard, SoftCard "lift".

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Card on hover and keyboard focus: same layers, the drop grows deeper and further down-right as the card rises 6 px. Always paired with that lift.

tokens.name: shadow-droplet
tokens.usage: Elevation 6 dp: the selection droplet.

tokens.name: shadow-soft-raised
tokens.usage: Soft (neumorphic) raised: SoftField raised, SoftCard, the white widget card. Two shadows, light top-left and dark bottom-right; the fill is the same as the ground under it.

tokens.name: shadow-soft-inset
tokens.usage: Soft pressed / inset: SoftField inset, a pressed SoftCard. Never for something that floats.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers that grow out of a trigger (MorphSelect), the Sidebar flyout. Higher than shadow-glass.

tokens.name: shadow-accent-glow
tokens.usage: Hover glow under an accent button and the accent alert. The only coloured shadow.

blur.note: Glass blur radius (Haze), multiplied by the Glass strength setting (0.5–1.5).

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Default glass: sidebar, captions, buttons, fields, banners.

tokens.name: blur-control
tokens.usage: The segmented switch track.

size.note: Fixed component sizes from the source, in dp (1 dp = 1 px at 100% Windows scaling and 1.0 interface size).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Segment height, tri-state chip height.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Button and icon button height; sidebar droplet height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Text field height.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Search field height.

tokens.name: segment-width
tokens.usage: Default width of one segmented option.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icon inside a button; signed-out account plus.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icon button, search, clear and banner icons.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Sidebar destination icons.

tokens.name: card-width
tokens.usage: Title card width (2:3 with card-height).

tokens.name: card-height
tokens.usage: Title card height.

tokens.name: row-cover-width
tokens.usage: Result row cover width (2:3).

tokens.name: row-cover-height
tokens.usage: Result row cover height.

tokens.name: rank-chip
tokens.usage: Rank chip square; also the account ring diameter.

tokens.name: sidebar-collapsed
tokens.usage: Sidebar width, icons only (50 px per item).

tokens.name: sidebar-expanded
tokens.usage: Sidebar width with labels (70 px per item).

tokens.name: sidebar-rail
tokens.usage: Space reserved for the collapsed sidebar, outer margin included.

tokens.name: control-cta
tokens.usage: ArrowButton and ToggleIconButton height; the knob is control-cta minus 8 px.

tokens.name: sidebar-item
tokens.usage: Row height in the Sidebar panel, and the icon cell on its collapsed rail.

tokens.name: sidebar-panel
tokens.usage: Sidebar width in the panel layout, expanded. Collapsed it uses sidebar-collapsed, like the pill.
